vercel.git.commit.author: svrnm
vercel.git.commit.message:
Set the region per service again

In a project with services, a top-level `regions` doesn't reach the
functions: they all ran in Vercel's default region (iad1), and every tool
call to PetClinic in eu-west-1 crossed the Atlantic and back. The region
goes back into each service's `functions`, and into eve's function
configs, which ignore `functions`.

Assisted-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
